The '''Lumbridge Swamp''' is located south of [[Lumbridge]] and is east of [[Draynor Village]]. It can be accessed via a small gateway at the back of the graveyard behind [[Lumbridge Church]]. Players can also access it via an entry south-east of Draynor Village, or they can swing across an [[Agility shortcut]] from [[Al Kharid]]. [[Zandar Horfyre]] will also teleport the player here, away from the [[Dark Wizards' Tower]], if they refuse to leave when going through his dialogue. It is also possible for players to get to the Lumbridge swamp by using a [[ring of the elements]] to teleport to the [[water altar|Water Altar]], or alternatively by travelling to the altar through the [[Abyss]] and exiting the portal. 

There are several [[fishing spots]] on the east end of the swamp that are ideal for novice anglers. There are two [[List of mines|mining sites]] in the swamp.

Hermit [[Father Urhney]] (from [[The Restless Ghost]] quest) can be found in the swamp as well as the entrance to the [[Lumbridge Swamp Caves]].

The starting point to the [[Lost City]] quest is in the swamp as well as the entrance to the lost city itself, [[Zanaris]]. The [[Misthalin Mystery]] quest can also be started by speaking to [[Abigale]] (or [[Hewey]], who sits next to her) in the south-east corner. 

The [[Water Altar]] is also located in the swamp, where players can craft water runes. 

Over a dozen [[Swamp tar]] spawns are scattered across the western half of the swamp.

==Places of interest==
===Fishing spots and the fishing tutor===
There are several [[fishing spots]] on the eastern shores of the swamp where players can [[Small fishing net|net]] and [[bait]] fish. The [[Fishing]] [[tutor]], [[Finlay]], can also be found here. He will give the player information on the basics of [[Fishing]] and information on all of the different ways players can fish. There are two [[small fishing net]] respawns located near the Finlay as well.

===Copper and tin mine===
{{main|East Lumbridge Swamp mine}}
A mine can be found south of the Fishing tutor along the south-eastern shores of the swamp. This mine is ideal for new players as it contains five [[copper rocks]] and five [[tin rocks]]. The [[Mining]] tutor, [[Monlum]], can also be found here. He will give the player information on the basics of Mining, and he will also give the player a [[bronze pickaxe]] if they so happen to require one.

===Water runic altar===
The [[Water Altar]] can be found in the south-central part of the swamp. Players will need to be level 5 [[Runecraft]] and have a [[water talisman]] or [[water tiara]] to enter.

===Entrance to Zanaris shed===
{{main|Zanaris|Lost City}}
A small shed can be found in the centre of the swamp. Inside, players can find several crates and some [[tools (gardening)|farming tools]]. If the player has completed the [[Lost City]] quest and is wielding a [[dramen staff]] or has completed the [[Lumbridge and Draynor Diary#Elite|Lumbridge and Draynor elite diary]], then they will be teleported to the city of [[Zanaris]] upon entering this shed. Players who have completed the diary are unable to enter this shed without teleporting to Zanaris, unless they are completing the [[Treasure Trails/Guide/Emote clues/Easy#Easy Emote clues|easy clue step]] ''"Dance in the shack in Lumbridge Swamp. Equip a bronze dagger, iron full helmet and a gold ring."'', in which case they are given an option to enter the shed.

===Lumbridge Swamp Caves===
A little north-west of the Water Altar is the entrance to the [[Lumbridge Swamp Caves]]. There is a [[candle seller]] near the entrance who will sell a [[candle]] for 1,000 [[coins]]. Players will need a [[light source]], a [[rope]], and a [[tinderbox]] to enter the caves safely. Taking a [[lit candle]] into the caves is dangerous as there is gas fumes in some areas.

===Father Urhney's house===
West of the [[Lumbridge Swamp Caves]] is [[Father Urhney]]'s house. He plays a key role in [[The Restless Ghost]] quest as he gives the player an [[amulet of ghostspeak]]. There is a [[leather gloves]] respawn in his house too.

===South-western mine===
{{main|West Lumbridge Swamp mine}}
South of [[Father Urhney]]'s house is another mine useful for more advanced players. There are seven [[coal rocks]], five [[mithril rocks]], and two [[adamantite rocks]].

===Adventurer's Camp (Lost City start point)===
{{main|Zanaris|Lost City}}
North of [[Father Urhney]]'s house is a small camp. It has a [[Monk (Lost City)|monk]], [[Wizard (Lost City)|wizard]], [[Archer (Lost City)|archer]], and [[Warrior (Lost City)|warrior]]. The monk, wizard, and archer will not talk to the player much, but talking to the warrior will start the [[Lost City]] quest. There is a [[pot]] item spawn north-east of their camp.

==Monsters==
*[[Giant rat]] (level 3 and 6)
*[[Goblin]] (level 5)
*[[Frog]] (level 5)
*[[Big Frog]] (level 10)
*[[Giant frog]] (level 13)
